title: Quick Crisp Tunisian Lamb Kebabs
description: A cultured and adventurous Tunisian dish featuring parsley and bhuna, this recipe is kosher-friendly and perfect for a weeknight dinner. The combination of lamb, parsley, and spices creates a unique and delicious flavor profile.
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, salt, and black pepper.
Add the lamb cubes to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the lamb cubes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Grill the kebabs for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, until the lamb is cooked through.
Meanwhile, mix the chopped parsley and bhuna spice blend in a small bowl.
Once the kebabs are cooked, brush them with the parsley and bhuna mixture.
Serve the kebabs hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
